I carried all their sorrow, mistaking it for fate. But what was passed down to me does not have to pass through me. The warmth that courses through my blood, in this fleeting moment, let the plague burn within my heart, through every day and every night. ♾️ Lyricist｜LÜCY, Moyka Composer｜LÜCY, Moyka, Eirik Hella Producer｜LÜCY, Moyka, Eirik Hella Arranger｜Eirik Hella Recording Engineer｜Eirik Hella, LÜCY Mixing Engineer｜Eirik Hella Mastering Engineer｜George Tanderø Cover Design｜lalo' maya' titiyon
